answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The zephyr is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the delta. The garden of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
